item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q021_nad_binding_convergent_evolution","answer":"NAD and NADP binding are not a single SCOPe homology signal. In SCOPe 2.08, several separate alpha/beta folds are explicitly annotated as dinucleotide-binding examples: c.2, “NAD(P)-binding Rossmann-fold domains,” with superfamily c.2.1; c.3, “FAD/NAD(P)-binding domain,” with superfamily c.3.1; c.25, “Ferredoxin reductase-like, C-terminal NADP-linked domain,” with superfamily c.25.1; and c.31, “DHS-like NAD/FAD-binding domain,” with superfamily c.31.1.
